maddeler.e:
أنسطل (form VII)
# أَنْسَطِلُ (ʔansaṭilu) /ʔan.sa.tˤi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
# أَنْسَطِلَ (ʔansaṭila) /ʔan.sa.tˤi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
# أَنْسَطِلْ (ʔansaṭil) /ʔan.sa.tˤil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
